entries.label: OSFI minimum qualifying rate (stress test)
entries.notes: Straight-switch exemption since Nov 21, 2024 (renew with a different lender without stress test). 4.5x loan-to-income portfolio cap for new lending. Lenders can go beyond MQR to GDS/TDS limits.
entries.source_note: OSFI Guideline B-20; MQR reaffirmed Jan 29, 2026 (house-affordability-research, verified 2026-09-27).
entries.value: Qualify at max(contract rate + 2 percentage points, 5.25%)

entries.label: OSFI stress-test history (for context copy)
entries.notes: Original 2018 test: 2pp or BoC 5-year posted rate. 2021: 5.25% floor.

value.2018_2021: contract + 2pp or BoC 5yr posted, whichever higher

entries.label: Gross Debt Service (GDS) ratio ceiling
entries.source_note: CMHC qualifying guidance (house-affordability-research, verified 2026-09-27). GDS/TDS conventions follow the mortgage qualification spec.

entries.label: Total Debt Service (TDS) ratio ceiling
entries.notes: With credit score >= 680. TDS conventions: unsecured revolving uses max(min payment, 3% of balance); secured/LOC uses 0.65% of limit per amortization 25y.

entries.label: Old GDS/TDS ceilings (context)
entries.notes: DO NOT use 35%/42% in any copy or calculator.
entries.value: 35%/42% - stale COVID-era values, do not use

entries.label: Minimum down payment tiers (federal, Dec 15, 2024)
entries.notes: Between $500k-$1.5M: 5% on first $500k + 10% on the rest. Above $1.5M is a hard cliff: 20% of the entire price (e.g. $1.6M -> $320k).

rejected.reason: Ceiling raised to $1.5M Dec 15, 2024. Seen stale on mortgagecapitalinvestment.com (Feb 2026) and spiremortgage.ca.

entries.source_note: Department of Finance Sept 2024 announcement (house-affordability-research, verified 2026-09-27).

entries.label: Insured mortgage amortization rules
entries.notes: 30-year availability applies to first-time buyers and buyers of newly-built homes, post Dec 15, 2024.

entries.label: CMHC mortgage insurance premiums (% of mortgage)
entries.notes: 0.20% surcharge applies to eligible 30-year amortization: 4.20%/3.30%/3.00%. PST applies on the premium in ON (8%), QC (9.975%), MB (7%), SK (6%). Premium is added to the mortgage, not paid up front (land transfer taxes are separate, paid in cash).

entries.label: Canadian semi-annual compounding conversion
entries.notes: Canadian mortgages quote nominal rates compounded semi-annually; convert to an equivalent monthly rate before computing payments.

entries.label: Ontario land transfer tax tiers (2026)
entries.notes: First-time homebuyer rebate up to $4,000 (max for fully-rebated price = $368,333).

entries.label: Toronto municipal land transfer tax tiers (2026, revised Apr 1, 2026)
entries.notes: Additional to Ontario LTT. First-time homebuyer rebate up to $4,475.
entries.source_note: City of Toronto MLTT page, Apr 1 2026 revision (down-payment-planner-research, verified 2026-09-27).

entries.label: Mortgage rate snapshot (September 2026, Ratehub)
entries.notes: SNAPSHOT - pull fresh at publish; do not treat as durable. Bank of Canada policy rate held at 2.25%; next decision Oct 28, 2026.
